newsitem.title: UK: MY SAYS KEEN ON MALBAK SHARE IDEAS.
newsitem.headline: MY SAYS KEEN ON MALBAK SHARE IDEAS.

text.p: Printing and packaging group M.Y. Holdings Plc said on Thursday it would welcome any decision by majority shareholder Malbak Ltd to distribute its stake in some way among Malbak shareholders.

South African diversified indutrial company Malbak has said this was one option it is considering as it weighs up structures whereby its shareholders could retain their effective interest in M.Y., although it may be inhibited by exchange control regulations.
Malbak has a 64-percent stake in M.Y.

In his statement to the British firm's annual meeting, M.Y. chief executive John Monks said the board regarded the process as positive news for shareholders, adding "among other benefits, it could lead to much increased liquidity in the group's shares".
In an upbeat trading review, Monks said that business so far in the current year had been good.

"The board is confident of reporting a satisfactory increase in profits for the first six months arising from increased volumes, improved efficiencies and the benefits of our capital expenditure programme," he added.
